fields.description: Program Description Program Features International students applying to this program are not required to provide proof of Chinese language proficiency at the time of enrollment. Students pursue in their major courses, as learning Chinese languages. Students are capable to attend classes with Chinese students after reaching the corresponding Chinese language proficiency (at least 220 points above in the new HSK5). Before graduation, the school can arrange corporate internships for students whose Chinese language proficiency has reached the standard. Main Courses The first year of the program (Chinese language study mainly): Integrated Chinese Language, Chinese Listening and Speaking, Chinese Reading and Writing, Business Chinese, Basic Chinese for International Trade, HSK Enhancement, Situation and Policy, China Overview, etc. The latter three years of the program (Chinese language ＋ professional training mode): International trade, international trade practice, international investment, international financial practice, cross-border e-commerce logistics management, international service trade, import and export trade simulation, fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Passport first page, visa page (please ensure continuity). * 2. Copy of senior high school graduation certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Graduation certificate must be certified by the Chinese Embassy (Consulate) in your country or notarized by a notary office in China. * 3. Official transcript Academic transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Transcripts must be certified by the Chinese Embassy (Consulate) in your country or notarized by a notary office in China. * 4. Non-criminal Record Certificate (Generally, it is valid for 3 or 6 months) It must be issued by your local police station with official stamp. * 5. Certificate of HSK * 6. 1-inch photo * 7. Physical Examination Form(only valid for 6 months) Please take it to hospital to have a checkup with all items, including personal information, photo, checking date, doctors' suggestion and signature. You can download a template or sample from here . * 8. Blank Page in Your Passport If you had not come to China before,please provide blank page in your passport. 9. Supporting Documents: Certificate of Good Conduct Provided by your current/previous school/company in Chinese/English to improve your success rate. You can download a template or sample from here . * 10. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants are required: more than 17 years old, high school graduate or above, physical and mental health, non-Chinese citizens holding foreign ordinary passports, and their status should be in accordance with the provisions of the Ministry of Education’s Education and Foreign Affairs Letter [2020] No. 12. 2. Applicants under the age of 18 are required to provide a letter of guarantee from their guardian. If the applicant’s parents are not in China, the applicant's parents need to appoint a foreigner or a Chinese person who usually resides in China as the guardian.
